description:
About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. Our multi-agent platform assesses complex business systems, designs their future state and executes change with greater speed, consistency and control.

We combine enterprise systems expertise with product engineering to address fragmented data, custom development, interconnected processes and years of accumulated business decisions.

Our architects shape both customer outcomes and the platform itself. Their expertise becomes reusable capabilities, so each engagement benefits from the lessons of the last.

The Opportunity

As our SAP Procure-to-Pay Architect, you will shape how customers transform procurement and payables, with a particular focus on ECC-to-S/4HANA programs.

You will own the end-to-end P2P architecture: requisitioning, purchasing, goods and service receipt, invoice processing, exceptions and payment, with integration to sourcing, contracts, supplier networks, inventory and finance.

Much of this work starts with procurement estates built up over many years: custom release strategies, legacy SRM scenarios, inconsistent supplier records, aged GR/IR balances, manual invoice workarounds and fragile interfaces. You will lead customers in distinguishing essential requirements from historical workarounds and establish processes their buyers, suppliers and accounts payable teams can trust.

Working directly with product and engineering teams, you will turn field experience into better assessments, stronger controls and reusable platform capabilities. Success means a defensible architecture, a controlled purchase-to-payment flow and sustained adoption, delivered with customer procurement and finance leaders and Tessera’s delivery teams.

What You Will Own

P2P Architecture and Design

  • Own P2P solution design, architectural recommendations and domain acceptance criteria, aligned with the Principal Solution Architect’s overall solution accountability.

  • Lead decisions across purchasing structures, requisitioning, source determination, agreements, pricing, account assignment, approvals, receipts and invoice verification, for direct, indirect and services procurement, including subcontracting, consignment and stock transfers.

  • Define invoice exception handling, matching tolerances, payment blocks, credit memos and supplier returns.

  • Own process continuity through to payment, partnering with R2R on valuation and automatic account determination, and with FI-AP and treasury on payment execution, bank connectivity and controls.

  • Define supplier integration for purchase orders, confirmations, shipping notifications and electronic invoices, including monitoring, retries and duplicate prevention.

  • Define reporting for procurement performance, contract compliance, invoice exceptions, GR/IR and payables.

  • Guide configuration and development teams, review functional specifications and document architectural decisions.

ECC-to-S/4HANA Transformation

  • Lead discovery across configuration, custom development, interfaces, supplier data, open documents and reconciliation gaps.

  • Recommend the P2P implications of system conversion, selective data transition or new implementation, and translate simplification items and readiness findings into scope, dependencies and remediation plans.

  • Guide supplier Business Partner and CVI readiness, flexible approvals, output management and inventory data-model changes, appropriate to the target release and deployment model.

  • Assess classic and lean services, SRM, supplier collaboration and source-to-pay integrations, including Ariba or central procurement where appropriate.

  • Define migration and reconciliation requirements for suppliers, info records, source lists, agreements, open orders, receipts, invoices, supplier balances and GR/IR.

Controlled Delivery and Adoption

  • Define integrated tests across requisition-to-payment, including approvals, service acceptance, partial deliveries, invoice-before-receipt, returns, reversals, failed interfaces, tax and payment.

  • Lead mock-conversion validation and cutover readiness across open orders, partial receipts, service entries, blocked invoices, supplier balances and GR/IR, coordinating in-flight payments with FI-AP and treasury.

  • Partner with controls and security teams on supplier onboarding, bank-detail changes, approval authority, duplicate-invoice prevention and segregation of duties.

  • Apply fit-to-standard and clean-core principles with technical architects.

  • Work with customer leaders to establish ownership of supplier, material and service data.

  • Drive adoption through practical knowledge transfer and resolution of the issues that prevent requesters, buyers and payables teams from trusting the new processes.

Platform and Product Development

  • Work with Tessera’s AI agents and engineers while retaining accountable architectural judgment.

  • Define validation checks, exception criteria and human review points for AI-assisted procurement work.

  • Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable rules, design patterns and controls, and validate platform outputs against customer evidence.

  • Support pre-sales with realistic assessments of scope, effort, dependencies and risk.

How You Will Work

You will lead P2P architecture across concurrent engagements, with involvement varying by project stage. You will work with Technical Program Managers on priorities, dependencies and capacity, and with configuration, development and delivery teams on implementation.

Your core expertise should be in SAP MM purchasing and logistics invoice verification, with command of the complete P2P process. You will own operational procurement-to-payment design and set boundaries with R2R, Plan-to-Produce, OTC, inventory, warehouse and tax teams. For maintenance procurement, EAM owns requirements and work execution, and P2P owns purchasing and supplier invoicing. Strategic sourcing and specialist platforms are addressed with the relevant domain experts.

We value hands-on investigation, clear recommendations and early escalation of risks and competing milestones, particularly around cutover and payment cycles.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of SAP procurement and P2P experience, including architectural leadership across complex transformations.

  • At least one completed S/4HANA procurement implementation or conversion, including go-live and stabilization.

  • Deep expertise in purchasing, source determination, agreements, pricing, approvals, account assignment, receipts and logistics invoice verification across direct, indirect and services procurement.

  • Strong command of procurement integration with finance: valuation, automatic account determination, GR/IR, invoice variances and the handover to payment through FI-AP, tax and treasury.

  • Experience with supplier Business Partner design, CVI, procurement data migration, open-document reconciliation and cutover.

  • Experience designing supplier interfaces and resolving cross-system exceptions.

  • Experience making fit-to-standard decisions and evaluating extensions with technical architects.

  • The ability to communicate architectural trade-offs to procurement and finance leaders, architects and engineers.

  • Evidence of sustained adoption, effective knowledge transfer and sound delivery across concurrent engagements.

  • Strong business English and effective collaboration across distributed teams.

  • The ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and assess its outputs critically. Within your first months, you will independently use Tessera’s platform to lead P2P assessments and contribute reusable improvements.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Experience We Value

Depth in one or more of the following is welcome:

  • SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, central procurement or SRM transformation.

  • Supplier invoice automation, e-invoicing and country-specific requirements.

  • SAP Fieldglass and contingent workforce procurement.

  • SAP Master Data Governance and supplier onboarding.

  • Maintenance and project procurement.

  • S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and Public Edition.

  • SAP Activate, SAP certifications or procurement qualifications.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Build working fluency in Tessera’s platform, understand your customer portfolio and establish P2P priorities, risks and decision ownership.

By 90 days: Lead assigned engagements with documented recommendations, agreed priorities and clear data, reconciliation and acceptance criteria. Feed field insights into platform improvements.

First year: Customer-validated milestones, stable purchasing and payment processes where programs reach production, sustained adoption and reusable platform capabilities used across engagements, measured against customer-agreed baselines for requisition-to-order cycle time, invoice exception rates, aged GR/IR and payment timeliness.

Why Join Tessera

  • Own consequential procurement architecture decisions with access to customer business and technology leaders.

  • Influence a product as well as individual implementations.

  • Work with engineers building AI-assisted enterprise transformation capabilities.

  • Turn hard-earned SAP experience into improvements that benefit multiple customers.

  • Help build the practices and standards of a growing Center of Excellence.

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.
